title: Kaneko Fumiko — The Cold Version #Shorts
description:
Behind Kaneko Fumiko sits an animal brain negotiating with a story it tells itself. Kaneko Fumiko (金子 文子, Kaneko Fumiko; January 25, 1903 – July 23, 1926) or rarely Pak Fumiko and Pak Munja (Korean: 박문자; Hanja: 朴文子), was a Japanese anarchist and nihilist. Kaneko Fumiko was born in the Kotobuki district of Yokohama, Japan, during the Meiji era.

The unconscious does not argue with Kaneko Fumiko; it simply acts first. She ended a relationship with Segawa, a socialist, after he dismissed concerns about the consequences of their relationship, such as pregnancy. She stated that she "expected him to take some responsibility" and realized she "was being toyed with and taken advantage of".
